purpose: Machine-readable capability registry for JSON-only Message API SGGK harness tasks and deterministic local gates.

unknown_policy.target_api: Resolve built-in and checked-in plugin capabilities first. For a trusted new-API adaptation task, return api_plugin_candidate only when a registered fixed archetype matches; otherwise return needs_harness_extension.
unknown_policy.body_builder: Return needs_harness_extension when a required body builder is not listed here.
unknown_policy.oracle: Map unknown oracle intent to a listed oracle only when the mapping is exact; otherwise return needs_harness_extension.

siliconflow_message_api.title: SiliconFlow GLM-5.2 Message API
siliconflow_message_api.production_boundary: The locked external SiliconFlow profile accepts public-interface tasks only and stages GLM-5.2 message.content JSON with provenance before fixed gates run.
siliconflow_message_api.description: Output produced by zai-org/GLM-5.2 through the configured SiliconFlow endpoint.

intranet_message_api.title: Intranet Message API
intranet_message_api.production_boundary: The configured intranet endpoint returns one JSON object in message.content; the gateway stages it with provenance before fixed gates run.
intranet_message_api.description: Output produced by the configured Message API model profile.

unknown_saved_output.title: Unknown saved output
unknown_saved_output.production_boundary: Saved JSON exists, but no provenance sidecar identified its source.
unknown_saved_output.description: Batch matrix status used when a saved JSON file exists without provenance metadata.

missing_output.title: Missing output
missing_output.production_boundary: No saved JSON exists for this request.
missing_output.description: Batch matrix status used when the expected saved JSON has not been produced.

invalid_provenance.title: Invalid provenance
invalid_provenance.production_boundary: The sidecar must be repaired before it can be trusted for audit.
invalid_provenance.description: Batch matrix status used when a provenance sidecar cannot be parsed or is not a JSON object.

unspecified_saved_output.title: Unspecified saved output
unspecified_saved_output.production_boundary: Saved JSON exists, but the sidecar omitted source_type.
unspecified_saved_output.description: Fallback status for provenance metadata that exists but does not name a source type.

attack_dsl.description: Preferred contract for api_boolean and source-guided geometry attacks. Supports parameter_clusters: named cluster_bases plus typed parameter clusters that fixed code expands deterministically (at most 50 cases per cluster) into 100k+ recipes for mass coverage.

cluster_seed.description: Seed that fixed code expands into attack DSL.

campaign_request.gate: campaign_profiles.py typed profile validation and shell=False argv resolution
campaign_request.description: Select a fixed local campaign profile plus bounded scalar args; command/tool/path fields are forbidden.

needs_harness_extension.description: Structured non-executable report used when the current harness cannot express the requested API, builder, or oracle.

api_plugin_candidate.description: Strict spec-only new-API adapter candidate. Fixed templates generate C++; the model cannot provide commands or CMake.

api_boolean_primitives.title: api_boolean primitive body pairs
api_boolean_primitives.description: Small primitive boolean pairs used for source-guided tolerance and oracle smoke cases.

api_boolean_generated_ops.title: api_boolean generated operation chains
api_boolean_generated_ops.description: Boolean attacks whose bodies come from generated or loaded topology rather than simple primitives.

exchange_import.title: STEP/IGES import
exchange_import.description: Import recipes and corpus handoffs for exchange-file topology.

exchange_roundtrip.title: STEP/IGES roundtrip
exchange_roundtrip.description: Export/import roundtrip checks against existing SGT bodies.

asset_replay.title: SGT asset replay
asset_replay.description: Replay and TopoCheck of saved SGT assets.

api_offset_body.title: Body offset flat recipes
api_offset_body.description: Flat recipes that construct or load one body, call api_offset_body, and validate topology/properties.

api_boolean_split.title: Boolean split flat recipes
api_boolean_split.description: Split one constructed or loaded target body with a supported body or plane-sheet tool and validate classified result counts.

api_boolean_slice.title: Boolean slice flat recipes
api_boolean_slice.description: Slice a target/tool body pair and validate the returned wire-body topology and counts.

api_offset2d.title: 2D curve offset flat recipes
api_offset2d.description: Offset bounded 2D line/arc paths and validate both successful paths and expected SDK diagnostic statuses.

api_topology_section.title: Topology section flat recipes
api_topology_section.description: Intersect two supported topology-bearing bodies and validate the distinct returned edge/vertex topology counts.

oracle_calibration.title: Oracle calibration
oracle_calibration.description: Small cases whose main purpose is calibrating oracle shape and diagnostics.

harness_extension.title: Harness extension request
harness_extension.description: Unsupported API, builder, or oracle requests that should not be forced through current gates.

single_case.title: Single case
single_case.description: One focused recipe or DSL case for a minimal smoke.

smoke.title: Smoke
smoke.description: Small bounded run for checking contract, validation, and one representative risk.

matrix.title: Tolerance matrix
matrix.description: Cross product or paired sweep over operations, placements, and tolerance bands.

corpus.title: Corpus
corpus.description: Dataset-backed run selected through a typed campaign profile with bounded arguments and fixed local bindings.

known_bug_regression.title: Known bug regression
known_bug_regression.description: Replay-focused run for existing assets or known failure signatures.

notes: Use DSL target/tool builders or chains.
Set stable id fields on chain steps that create, split, trim, or transform topology.
For tolerance risks, use sweeps or paired_sweeps around exact contact, geom_tol, and topo_tol.

For mass coverage (100k+ cases), use cluster_bases plus parameter_clusters with typed cluster types such as translate_axis, contact_band, size_dimension, angle_sweep, tolerance_sweep, large_coordinate_shift, boolean_type_cycle, option_toggle, mirror_sign, seeded_jitter, translate_line, scale_uniform, uv_domain, and enum_cycle; each cluster expands to at most 50 cases, so combine many bases, types, and grids instead of enumerating cases.
Use target_* and tool_* fields; plane_sheet is the minimal supported planar splitter.
Use split_outer_bodies, split_inner_bodies, split_wire_bodies, and split_total_bodies for classified count bounds.
boolean_type is optional and defaults to UNION.
Slice results are wire-type bodies; prefer slice_result_bodies and slice_wire_bodies count bounds.
Use exactly one uniform offset2d_distance or one offset2d_distances value per path segment.
Expected non-success statuses are valid test outcomes when expectations.offset2d_status matches the SDK result.
Use source_kind plus source_* fields for primitive inputs.
For loaded_sgt, use source_file and source_body_index.
offset_distance must be a non-zero number; unsupported or failed SDK statuses remain explicit in status.json.
The initial adapter accepts body-producing target/tool builders while preserving edge and vertex results as separate topology artifacts.
Use topology_section_edges, topology_section_vertices, and topology_section_total count bounds; do not treat these outputs as bodies.
Use a flat recipe with api=check_sgt and a source_file.
For non-body SGT topology assets, report topology counts rather than body property oracles.
Use source_file pointing at .step or .stp.
Follow import with corpus discovery or SGT recut when imported bodies should be attacked further.
Use source_file pointing at .iges or .igs.
Follow import with corpus discovery or SGT recut when imported bodies should be attacked further.
Use a source .sgt body, export to STEP, import back, then compare properties and bbox.
Select AP203, AP214, or AP242 explicitly when source risk names an exchange protocol.
Use a source .sgt body, export to IGES, import back, then compare properties and bbox.
Set face-only or SGK specified data flags only when the risk calls for them.
Return an extension request instead of pretending the runner supports the API.
Include the minimal new recipe shape and one concrete smoke case.
Input must be a manifold sheet body; thickening interval must include 0 (the base surface) for the SDK to find lateral edges successfully.
The defaulted ThickenOpts parameter is omitted so the SDK default is used.

result_bodies.guidance: Assert result_bodies min/max when non-empty or empty output is part of the truth.

split_body_counts.guidance: Assert classified split output counts with exact integers or min/max bounds.

slice_body_counts.guidance: Assert the number of wire-type bodies returned by api_boolean_slice.

offset2d_status.guidance: Match the named Offset2DStatus, including an expected non-success diagnostic status.

offset2d_result_paths.guidance: Assert exact or bounded output-path counts for api_offset2d.

topology_section_counts.guidance: Assert edge and standalone-vertex results separately because api_topology_section does not return bodies.

properties.guidance: Assert finite length/area/volume and metric ranges when analytic bounds are known.

boolean_volume_relation.guidance: Use sample_input_properties=true only for stable solid boolean inputs.

boolean_bbox_relation.guidance: Use boolean_bbox_relation only for stable solid boolean inputs with predictable extents.

point_relation.guidance: Use named key_points and point_ref for critical inside/outside/boundary probes.

face_point_relation.guidance: Prefer uv_fraction or uv on selected faces unless an exact 3D face point is known.

clash.guidance: Use role_a/role_b among target, tool, and result with NoClash, AnyClash, or exact ClashType.

distance.guidance: Use minimum distance for clearance/tangency and set expected/min/max with explicit tolerances.

plane_extreme.guidance: Use exact coordinate-plane distance probes for hard min/max coordinate oracles.

roundtrip_comparison.guidance: Rely on roundtrip_comparison.json for STEP/IGES source/result drift.

topocheck.guidance: TopoCheck is always part of runner pass/fail for supported body outputs.
